end_to_end.expected: Fresh profile: Display shows checked, enabled 'Show opponent styles at the table'; unticking (mouse on label, or Tab+Space) saves showOpponentStyles:false at once; reload keeps it unchecked; new table: 5 bot seats show name + $stack only (no style, no '·'), user seat present; Game Config line-up still shows styles; paused session + change + Resume applies both directions; invalid record -> defaults (checked, labels shown), error logged, next change writes a valid record; other non-default fields preserved by toggling; checkbox disabled until settings read; axe clean.
end_to_end.actual: All observed as expected in both browsers (16/16 holdout browser checks pass). With the settings read held back by a page script the checkbox stayed disabled (and checked) for >800 ms, a forced click changed nothing, and it became enabled once the read was released, with the stored record still the defaults. Seeded {defaultSpeed:'realistic', autoOpenReview:false, fourColourDeck:true, botBanter:false} survived off/on toggles unchanged. Invalid records (wrong type, missing fields, non-object) all fell back to defaults with 'Settings could not be read' logged, and the next change repaired the record. Checkbox bounding box >= 44x44; axe zero serious/critical with the toggle on and off.
